description: This file defines a PHP class 'License' within a namespace related to the OrangeHRM application. The class extends a base display field class and provides method implementations for obtaining DTO class name, entity aliases, and associated fields, specific to the 'License' display element in a report module.

classes.name: License
classes.description: A class representing a report display field for license information, extending ListableDisplayField and providing specific implementations for DTO class, entity aliases, and report fields.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object associated with this display field, specifically 'Dto\,License'.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in querying or reporting context, here returning ['license'].

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of database fields associated with this display element, here ['employee.empNumber'].
